ui.btn_import_list_tooltip:
Queue several downloads at once from a text file.
One line per download:  URL | destination folder | filename (optional)
Lines starting with # and blank lines are skipped.
ui.chk_shutdown: Shut down PC after downloads finish (forced!)
ui.chk_shutdown_tooltip:
Forced shutdown (shutdown /s /f):
ALL programs are closed – unsaved Word
documents etc. will be lost!
A 60-second countdown with a cancel button
runs before shutting down.
ui.chk_catch_tooltip:
Starts a local receiver. The "PersistDL Catcher" Chrome extension intercepts downloads (e.g. from Civitai)
and hands them here instead of downloading them in the browser.
ui.civitai_token_tooltip:
Civitai → Account Settings → API Keys → create a new key.
Automatically appended to civitai.com download links.
ui.btn_clear_list_tooltip:
Removes ALL entries from the list (finished and running).
Running downloads are cancelled. Already downloaded files
remain on disk - only the list is cleared.
ui.hint_bottom: Remove and show-in-folder: right-click an entry. Paused/cancelled downloads resume from the exact remembered byte position – even after restarting the program.
